correctness.rationale: Block seed is integral and p-adically nonzero; Lucas yields a nonzero residue. Every allowed base-p^s concatenation stays carry-free for both numerator and lower index; the denominator is divisible by p. Distinctness, counting, and both Hausdorff dimension estimates follow. Standalone finite verifier reports 2387 binary-block samples.
